notice: Illustrative training fixture only. These invented requirements are not verified travel rules.

rules.title: Training passport validity
rules.body: Invented exercise rule: present a passport valid on the travel date. An expired sole passport requires denial when no replacement can be obtained.

rules.title: Training visitor permission
rules.body: Invented exercise rule: fictional XZ visitors need a current TRAINING-VISITOR visa with at least one entry remaining, unless an explicitly stated training exception applies. Resolve an available permission inquiry before denial.

rules.title: Training resident exception
rules.body: Invented exercise rule: a current TRAINING-RESIDENT permit may replace a visitor visa. The permit must actually be presented.

rules.title: Training supervisor referral
rules.body: Invented exercise rule: a TRAINING-MANUAL-REVIEW permit whose status cannot be clarified after the offered inquiry requires supervisor escalation. Escalation is not a fallback for other cases.

rules.title: Training connecting journey
rules.body: Invented exercise rule: for the authored SFO–LHR–DUB connection, also request and receive the confirmed onward booking. This is not a statement of actual transit law.

rules.title: Training alternative passports
rules.body: Invented exercise rule: the authored dual-document passenger may present either a current fictional XY passport or a current visitor visa in addition to the initial passport.
